classification.difficultyReason: Apply the specified cosine rule, rearrange and factorise a quadratic, then report the two positive side lengths explicitly requested.

content.prompt: Use the cosine rule to find the two possible values of $x$ in the diagram.

spec.description: Unshaded triangle with a horizontal base, an upper vertex to the left of the base midpoint, and all ordinary strokes and labels in black.
spec.mathematics: The base is 8; the left sloping side is x; the right sloping side is 7. The included angle between x and 8 is 60 degrees. The figure depicts one possible configuration without supplying a value of x.
spec.answerVisibility: All side labels and the 60-degree angle are permanent question givens; no answers are shown.
